name: micrometer
description: An application observability facade for the most popular observability tools. Think SLF4J, but for observability.

issues.title: MeterFilters configured after a Meter has been registered
Document the behavior and expectations of NamingConvention
Pause Detection contributes to count when it should just contribute to total time.
Associate multiple values with the same tag key
Better support for working with Observation from Kotlin
Unregister meters whose weak reference has been broken
Allow disabling of sum, count, and max timer metrics being sent to DataDog.

latest_release.body:
## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Preserve whitespace in HTTP Basic authentication passwords [#8015](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/8015)
- Missing reflection hint for getProcessCpuTime [#7911](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7911)
- Proxy JMS session results using the method's declared return type [#7896](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/7896)
- Kotlin interoperability for CaffeineCacheMetrics broken/requires unchecked cast to work [#7582](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7582)
- Registering/Updating a MultiGauge while a Prometheus scrape occurs can lead to DuplicateLabelsException [#6851](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/6851)
- OTLP histogram bucket count does not equal count intermittently [#6006](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/6006)
- Statsd UDP epoll warn logs are verbose when statsd is down #2624

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Fix typos in docs [#8000](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/pull/8000)
- Add docs for `@MeterTag` when used on a method [#7829](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7829)
- Document best practice about configuring registries on a composite [#7367](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/7367)
- Documentation on `SpelValueExpressionResolver` is unclear [#6465](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/6465)
- Document how to customize tags in micrometer-java11 HttpClient instrumentation [#4962](https://github.com/micrometer-metrics/micrometer/issues/4962)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Bump io.netty:netty-bom from 4.2.18.Final to 4.2.19.Final #8042
